agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on October 30th, 2024 in Emergency Preparedness and Protective Services Committee Report 14.
The deadline to register by phone to speak or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Wednesday, October 16, 2024, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on Thursday, October 17, 2024.
agenda_items.minutes: These “Summary Minutes” indicate the disposition of items and actions taken at the meeting. This document does not include all of the text that will be included in the full Minutes, such as the record of written and oral submissions. Recorded votes and dissents contained in the Summary Minutes are draft until the full Minutes of the meeting are confirmed by the Committee. The draft of the full Minutes (for confirmation) will be published with the agenda for the next regular Committee meeting and, once confirmed, will replace this document.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
At the outset, Mr. Ryan Perrault, General Manager, Emergency and Protective Services Department (EPSD), introduced Ms Valerie Bietlot, Manager, Business and Technical Support Services, EPSD, and Mr. David Kurs, Specialist, By-law Review, EPSD who, in turn, spoke to a detailed slide presentation overview of the report.  A copy of this report is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.
Mr. David Chapman, Director, By-Law and Regulatory Services, EPSD, and Ms Harpreet Grewal, Supervisor, Ottawa Public Health, were also present to respond to questions.
The Committee then heard from Mr. Ron Couchman, Owner, Clear Sky Vapes.Following the receipt of the delegation, and following questions to staff and Committee discussion, the report recommendations were put before Committee and were ‘CARRIED’, as presented.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
At the outset, Mr. Ryan Perrault, General Manager, Emergency and Protective Services Department (EPSD) introduced Ms Beth Gooding, Director, Public Safety Service, EPSD, who spoke to a detailed slide presentation overview of the report.  A copy of this presentation is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.  
Following questions to staff and discussion by the Committee, the report recommendations were put before Committee and were ‘CARRIED’, as presented.

motions.motion_text:

That the Emergency Preparedness and Protective Services Committee recommend Council:

sub_agendas_items.title: 9-1-1 Annual Report 2023
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Ms Beth Gooding, Director, Public Safety Service, Emergency and Protective Services Department, introduced Mr. Eric Janus, Director, Communications Branch, Ottawa Police Service, who was present to respond to questions.  Ms Gooding then spoke to a slide presentation overview of the report.  A copy of this presentation is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.
The Committee then heard from Mr. Michael Wood.
Following the receipt of the delegation, and following questions to staff and Committee discussion, the report recommendation was put before Committee and was ‘CARRIED’, as presented.
